pages.title: The trip
pages.text: Three of us, one mountain. Bédoin at dawn, the forest section before the heat arrived, then the white limestone moonscape all the way to the top.

pages.title: Bédoin, the summit, back via Malaucène
pages.text: Up the classic side from Bédoin: twenty-odd kilometres of climbing, the last six above the tree line. Coffee and a jacket at the top, then the long, fast drop to Malaucène and an easy roll home in time for lunch.
Bald mountain: done. Alpe d'Huez is next.
